title: I searched out a drinking app and…
text: I searched out a drinking app and randomly landed here. BAM! Supportive REAL community, daily readings that are optional but fact based, it just has all the things I needed. There’s no guilt, no shame, it’s SUPPORT. My drinking is down by like 80% and I’ve had quite a few weeks of no alcohol. Give it a try. You’ll see
author: Dena Kelley

title: LIfe Changing and Love It!
text: I joined reframe 152 days ago having drunk too much every day for over 30 years. My brother uses Reframe to help him cut back so I joined to do that. The amazing approach of educating me on the neuroscience behind why we drink was game changing! It’s no coincidence that I’m 152 days sober and LOVING life. The support of this community is INCREDIBLE and I’m never looking back and know so much of a better more fun future is ahead of me!
author: Philippa Laxton

title: Great features. Appalling support  if you are in Aus/NZ - UK
text: The app has some fantastic features. One of the very best features that keeps a lot of people engaged and returning to the app (according to both app members and a news article that interviewed the creators) was being able to attend group Zoom meetings. This is the thing that sets it apart from similar apps.  These meetings are led by coaches and create a wonderful sense of support and community.  The meetings are absolutely fantastic. There are so many different topics covered so something for everyone regardless of the journey you’re on regarding alcohol. The problem is because of the time zone difference if you are in Australia or New Zealand there are only a few meetings a week you can go to — whereas if you are in the US there are several (up to 9 meetings per day!!!!) . The coach that covered a 5:30 pm Australian /NZ (ps a lot of UK and European residents attended this as well) time meeting is on leave and Reframe have completely dropped the ball (for approx. 3 weeks now) despite many messages from attendees of that meeting and despite messages from several of the coaches.   Reframe has done nothing to fill this spot for the last few weeks. Some of the coaches  (Who run the meetings) have stepped up out of the goodness of their hearts at 3am their US time!  to host this meeting and make it possible — this is obviously unsustainable. There have also been scheduled meetings that many attendees show up for and there is no coach. We’ve discovered this is not the coaches fault but rather scheduling complacency from Reframe.The coaches are truly amazing. The support and interest from the company itself is absolutely appalling. There are qualified people in Australia who have mentioned they are willing to host those meetings.  Absolutely no response from Reframe.  Crickets.  Nothing.  Despite many members reaching out to Reframe.  Incredibly disappointing. When you attend these meetings most people say they would be lost without them - even from USA attendees.  With over 6 million subscribers, I am pretty sure the coffers would allow for one meeting per day in Australia (or Australian later afternoon time zone that would allow for NZ and European attendees) , which is when a lot of people are triggered to drink. Many of of the meetings in the US are later  in the day for them.  My subscription runs out next month and I am seriously considering not resubscribing because of this, I know of others who are also in the community who are possibly not re joining because of this. I am happy to pay their annual cost — but not if there is such a great gap in who the resources are allocated to. They should tell you before you subscribe that if you are in Southern Hemisphere there will be very little possibility for attending the meetings. Love the content. Super disappointed in support/follow-up and Reframe’s disinterest and lack of response to many many members reaching out for clarification on future meetings. Seems money making is more important  than a true sense of  what the app was originally designed for.
author: Hels Hels

title: Tremendous Impact
text: Reframe has made a tremendous impact on my life. It has given me structure and support from the community of Reframers. I have learned so much from the daily check-in's and lessons. I have benefitted from the shame-free approach and continue to improve.
author: David

title: Poor customer service
text: I was charged close to $200, in 2 separate charges, for a renewal I didn’t want and had not authorized. I have been trying for over 2 weeks to get a refund. They finally refunded the smaller of the two charges but continue to stonewall me on the larger one. While I have no complaint about the application itself, the customer service is appalling.
author: Linda Towry

title: Amazing Community!
text:
Reframe wraps the learning and community suport needed for recovery into one platform.  The community ethos of open tolerance and love is healing.  I am so glad I found it as the main tool to help me get sober.
Only downside--some of the tech behind the app feels clunky.
author: Michael Slater

title: Reframe is saving my life.
text: Reframe is saving my life. It’s where you can find a truly supportive and judgement free community (the reframbly)! I’ll keep renewing every year.
author: Lauren Morris

title: Neuroscience of Alcohol
text:
I love this Reframe App!
It has so much valuable neuroscience information and an amazing supportive community! 
I joined on cutback and ended up switching to Alcohol Free because I felt SO much better!! 26 months AF
author: Kim Sleeper

title: Science-Backed, Connection, Coaches
text: Reframe is home to an amazing community of people and full of compassionate, knowledgeable coaches. The forum, the meetings, the coaches, the PEOPLE, the daily tasks help make sobriety possible.
author: anon

title: Can't cancel my subscription
text: I have been trying to cancel my subscription. It isn't possible in the app, in the Google Play store or on the website. I have emailed help @reframeapp.com, support @reframeapp.com, and hello @reframeapp.com and can get no response! Ridiculous how they make it IMPOSSIBLE to cancel. Stay away!!
author: April

title: Renews even though cancelled and support / help doesn't respond
text:
I used the app from 24th February 2026 and subsequently cancelled my subscription in June yet a payment came out of my account in August. I did not receive a notification of a renewal, they just took the money from my bank using applepay. I contacted support and had a response to say "I can sort this for you, but first can you tell me why you're leaving"

I responded to that email and followed up every day since. I also emailed help@reframe... and still no response. 

It is unethical to take money from a persons account in the first place, without sending a renewal alert. It's even more unethical to do this after a subscription is cancelled. I'd like a response please and also my money back.
author: Mr and Mrs Holloway, gallowshaw, morpeth.

title: I am baffled by the poor reviews
text: I am baffled by the poor reviews! This app is incredible. It has everything you could need and more to quit drinking. And customer service is incredible. I lost access to the app... Entirely my own fault because there was a problem with the payment of my renewal subscription. It was rectified within 3 hours of me messaging! And customer support were really kind to boot. I cannot fault this app, or the support, in any way. Day 12 sober 🎉
author: Jane Callan

title: I signed up for the $49.99 every 3…
text: I signed up for the $49.99 every 3 months deal. I also signed up for a couple add-ons at $19.99 each. I don't even remember what those were for but I don't think whatever it was I paid for that I'm getting. but what's really appalling to me as I jumped into a meeting and I it was my fourth meeting. the first three were okay one of them was amazing. but right from the get-go this meeting became about hating white men and then the chat was negative the comments were negative it just became this evil nasty divisive bigoted disgusting thing. and let me tell you they're a little zoom is not easy to navigate and I was subjected to way too much of that while I was trying to figure out how to turn that dang meeting off. the chat was negative the video is negative and the coach says to this girl oh you and I could be friends and so that told me where her heart was. that she embraced all that negative horrible diarrhea spewing from that woman's mouth right from the beginning and that set the tone for the entire meeting. I don't want to single dime of mine going towards that kind of hate and racism. I have sent an email to support. and I'll probably have to end up trying to go through my credit card to get my money back. but I'm not supporting racism and sexism under the guise of healthcare. nope
author: Maria Nash

title: Impossible to cancel
text: Impossible to cancel. Impossible to get a refund. Customer support never responds
author: GregCO

title: Daylight robbery and horrendous customer services
text: Absolutely shocking, stay clear. I signed up on their website paying £25. Got the receipt through. Then the website sent me to download the App. I did this and  entered my details and it asked me to pay even more after going through all the questions again. Iv emailed them 3 times with no response. So im now in the process of going through UK consumer rights to claim my money back as on their website you can't get refunds, but I havent even had any sort of service as I can't access a account
author: james bassett

title: AVOID for Privacy Concerns / Data Loss
text:
The Reframe app is faulty. Their "customer service" is atrocious and essentially non existent. After paying $173.17 in subscription fees they lost all of my data. Reframe rolled out an app update causing the app to not function AT ALL for days. Not only was a single communication not provided to customers, they lied to customers and said an email was sent out. After about a week the app was "fixed" but my account was completely wiped of my data. Three years worth of logging was no where to be found. 
It has been a month now with no resolution. I have repeatedly contacted them to no avail.
Their so called customer service responds once a week or so after I ask for an update on fixing my issue saying things like "thank you for your patience whats the email you use to login" after I've provided it numerous times.

Reframe took my money, lost my data due to their shotty update, provided no communication no resolution and no refund. Reframe is a scam and deceptive. If you have any privacy concerns with sharing your personal data with an app AVOID REFRAME.
author: Hay

title: Reframe is great if you want to QUIT…
text:
Reframe is great if you want to QUIT alcohol.
I found that the guidance for wanting to cut back seemed odd as they were  coaching tips from folks that had two DUIs. I just really was thinking that that app would suggest tips and tricks from individuals who had similar experiences or goals.
If you are looking for something to cut back on the glass of wine per night it’s not really set up for those people despite saying it’s for cutting back. It really is geared for quitting only. Also I found the number of check ins to be a lot. I was at the minimum amount and it was still 15 mins a day at various intervals.
author: Heather MacDonald

title: REFRAME is a Great Mate to have!
text: The best part about Reframe is that it's not the slightest bit "judgy". It also SUGGESTS "reduction" rather than abstinence. I haven't had a drink for 6 months and I am enjoying my life without the "other guy" (my booze habit) around all the time. THANKS REFRAME!
author: Paul

title: Your app sucks
text: Your app sucks! Worked for a week, updated and now won't open. Get your shit together!
author: Brian Maxwell

title: Changed my mind - literally
text: Initially I had difficulty logging onto the site - which caused me to write a 1 * review...but I have to say now I am consuming the content my views have changed.  Its a thought-provoking and supportive app which has already helped to  alter my drinking habits just a few days in.  It is analytical so it appeals to the way my brain works. It is an American app - so the pull is pretty global.  I would recommend.  My only concern is ongoing cost - I have not bought any extras and paid for 3 months.  It is not clear how to unsubscribe and something I need to find out.

title: A fantastic app
text: A fantastic app, with such amazing education and inspiration.  i have learnt so much and it makes me keep wanting to learn more while inspiring me to cut back on my drinking and engage in healthier habits.  Also wonderful support staff and great service
author: Donna Ashton

title: Amazing- seriously
text: Amazing- seriously. It’s a real community with real people. I’ve met and made friends off this wanting a better, healthier life. Perfect for science-based reduction of alcohol
author: Poseidon

title: This app is amazing
text: This app is amazing.  The amount of resources it provides are absolutely amazing!  I love the daily lessons and journal entries.  Everyday there are meeting to join on Zoom where I enjoy connecting with others.  I have learned and grown so much from this app.  Before I joined, I struggled to be sober for 1 day and now I am on day 39 alcohol free!

text: Fantastic coaches, inspirational reframe community, forum, challenges, daily readings, affirmations, online group meetings, habit trackers, plus the green cups! Reframe is a great place!

author: Cindy Brandvold

title: The community of people that are there…
text: The community of people that are there to support your decision to quit or cut back your alcohol intake. I find the meetings to be extraordinarily helpful and supportive. This app is a safe community to share your experiences- good or bad. All of the coaches are great, with individual strengths that they each bring to the groups.
author: Christina Fish

title: IT WORKS, IT’S WORTH IT, YOU’RE WORTH IT
text: This community, from the people, the coaches to the app itself is absolutely amazing. I was able to quit my drinking habit as a result. There is not a more friendly, science backed program out there for people who want to explore their relationship with alcohol. Whether you are cutting back, mindfully moderating or Alcohol Free, you will benefit here and it’s a safe place for everyone! I’m a licensed psychotherapist and I’ve never seen anything like this for help with addiction recovery.
author: KD

title: Transformative
text: Transformative. Legit. Amazing.
author: Alexandra Zazzara

title: HIGHLY RECOMMEND ⭐️
text: Reframe is a fantastic app that lifts up members with unconditional positive regard. The tools are abundant and the coaches are diverse, skilled, and compassionate.it is the best place to improve your relationship with alcohol.
author: Jenny Munro

title: I saw quite a few ads for Reframe on…
text:
I saw quite a few ads for Reframe on social media which really caught my attention in regards to my excessive alcohol consumption.  I decided to try the app for 30 days for free and have not only enjoyed using the app but have remained alcohol free now for 28 days.  I thought I wanted to just drink less but the education about what harmful things that I’m doing to my mind and body convinced me to remain totally alcohol free.

Contained within the app are tons of daily informational topics, discussion forums, zoom meeting links, videos, journaling. The beauty of it is that you can choose to do the activities that work for you and ignore the rest.

I’ve never had any billing problems, I’ve been charged exactly as advertised.  I’ve had one glitch involving a small forum group that I participate in but the 3 times that I’ve submitted a help case for this minor issue I’ve gotten a personalized response within hours.

I’ve raved about the app to my wife and others.  It’s so much more than just an app, it is a connection with real people who are all in the same boat, that boat being an unhealthy relationship with alcohol.  It’s really a community connection tool.

The cost is reasonable and I feel absolutely safe talking with the other Reframe members and coaches.

One final comment.  I feel so much better today than I did 28 days ago mentally, physically, and spiritually.  I will definitely be upping my subscription to the annual plan.  I wish I had tried this sooner!!
author: Trip Farris

title: Helpful learning and support tool
text: This app has helped me make positive lifestyle changes that I wouldn't have been capable of on my own. Reframe is an outstanding and supportive community of people working towards similar goals. It's absolutely worth it!
author: Jennifer B

title: Reframe has given me the knowledge
text:
Reframe has given me the knowledge  , support & encouragement to finally break free from the chains of drinking !!!
It has daily tasks, meetings where you can share or just listen, new  challenges each month & connection with others going thru the same things ! You are not alone, & they "get it", they truly do ! 
If I could give it 10 stars 🌟,  I would !!!
It totally has given me the ability to break free of the prison I was in for so many years ! A true sense of community is felt here ! It is an integral  part of my daily life,& has given me freedom & peace ✌️ Grateful for finding this life saving app !❤️
author: Kim Murphy

title: I love Reframe, zero billing or subscription issues
text: I love Reframe. It's made it possible for me to go alcohol free. The Coaches, meetings, and community are beyond what I hoped for. I signed up for 6 Mos. for 69.99.renewable after that. I've had 0 issues with the subscription or billing.
author: Susan

title: Reframe is Amazing
text: Reframe is Amazing!  Great community helping support changing your relationship with alcohol.  The positivity is key but so is the convenience of an online community.
author: Amy Koonce

title: Reframe is AWESOME!
text: Reframe has changed my life for the better! I have struggled with alcohol since the first drink. I have worked on sobriety in other programs on and off for over 25 years. I found reframe a year ago and loved the option to do a cutback program, I didn’t have to commit to not drinking. It worked well for me and then I decided to go Alcohol free and it’s been great! I am 7 months AF. I love the app, I love the meetings on the app and there are tools for every kind of learner and personality. Reframe is awesome!!
author: Shannon B

title: Reframe.  Resource to rediscovering my life alcohol free.
text:
I really enjoy having reframe as an option/tool to adjust my relationship with alcohol.   Some might find the cost to be an issue, but I personally have spent that, if not more, on a night out in just drinks.   

I love the community reframe has created, and really appreciate the modern approach to alcohol.  AA wasn’t a great option for me, but reframe is everything I needed it to be.

It provides tools, guidance and an extremely supportive and welcoming community for anyone and everyone. There really is something for everyone on this platform. Five giant starts.

author: customer

title: AMAZING
text: the community has been indispensable in my journey to an AF life
author: christopher freel

title: Salvation lies within
text: There is something for everyone in Reframe; and for me it was breaking the cycle of addiction, the suffering it caused, and most importantly finding who I am. I have discovered acceptance, love and peace. The meetings are part of my daily life and I wouldn't have it any other way. The community is family, and the coaches, I believe deep in my heart, are angels from above. The coaches are compassionate, loving, accepting and have drawn out my inner child and taught me how to love him again. I really don't know where I would be without Reframe.

title: I love Reframe!

I would highly recommend it to anybody who is wanting to change their relationship with alcohol. Thank you Reframe!
author: Byron Ridenour

title: It is an easy way to feel supported on…
text: It is an easy way to feel supported on a healthier life journey. Many levels of interaction and goes at whatever pace you choose.
author: Megan Dedic

title: THANK YOU REFRAME for helping make my life more manageable and healthier
text: I came to Reframe a few years ago on a cutback journey that turned AF with the help of the app. Then, I took a break until this year. Since then, they have upgraded the app and added SO many improvements with valuable AI tools etc. I now frequently attend a wide variety of live meetings with professional coaches and find that they along with the friendly community reinforce my newly embraced long term alcohol free lifestyle. I adore the Creatives, Habits Weekly, Healthy Strategies and Neurodivergence meetings and Speaker Shares along with the forum and monthly challenges! Too bad I didn’t utilize the app as much the first time I joined and stuck with the it or I probably would have avoided the current DUI situation I am facing. Being able to wake up and turn on meetings in my pocket with my phone and ear buds and find my people along with personable coaching and effective tools for cravings is absolutely priceless to me🙏🦋🌱🌸🕊️💕🧠⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
author: Consumer

title: My experience with Reframe has been fantastic
text: My experience with Reframe has been fantastic. It’s a community I have found to help guide me through my sobriety journey. The app offers monthly challenges, daily readings that are science based and several meetings per day that you can attend via zoom. The meetings are a great place for support in real time from people on the same path. If I could give it 6 stars, I would.

title: A community that helps you succeed
text: A community that helps you succeed.  Best coaches around. So many options for meetings and a great toolkit. ❤️
author: Court

title: This app and the community saved me

Some of the negative reviews make me sad. Not for Reframe’s but for those who were not able to experience the magic that can happen on the app
author: Mary Pry Woerner

title: Reframe has helped me change and save…
text: Reframe has helped me change and save my life in so so so many ways! Can't express what this place means to me!
author: JASMINE

There are so many resources, from daily readings, monthly challenges, online journaling with prompts, a drink tracker, an active forum, videos, book reviews, small user led groups, courses, zoom meetings, etc. The community is phenomenal and the support and encouragement are amazing. text: Reframe is an excellent program for reframing one’s relationship with alcohol. It offers science-based education, live meetings hosted by trained coaches, a forum of peers who support each other, a podcast, personal coaching (for an additional fee), and so much more. I joined on a free trial offer that was no different from other subscription programs and was adequately explained and I haven’t had any billing issues. I have, however, changed my life for the better in every way possible. I’m grateful for this awesome program.
author: babette faith

title: The community is amazing

author: Ashley Havel

title: Reframe found me!
text:
Reframe is bringing me to where I want to be regarding alcohol. No judgement.
No judgement. No judgement. 

The app, the meetings and the coaches, are just what I needed.
author: Mary

title: I was appreciating the ability to track…

title: Would not recommend this at all
text:
I contacted email as suggested by reframe to ask why they took the extra charges out and to provide a refund two weeks ago and have had no response. 

Would not recommend this at all, I was charged $70.04 then $28.01 and again $28.01 in the same day,  I did not agree to these second and third charges (2 x $28.01) and in my case the app is no help at all, I open it and it tells me i have had a alcohol free day but I didn't.  A total rip off, no value for money. I feel like I have totally been taken advantage of. I read the reviews on Trustpilot and they all seemed positive.  I thought best to leave my experience so people get a balanced view.
author: JD

title: OG Reframe User Weighing In
text: I’ve been using Reframe since 2021. I’ve got zero bad things to say about it. Reframe and their meetings played a huge role in my sobriety journey:  Shout outs to Kevin Ballack, Static, Kiola Raines & Jay Chase—without the assistance of these Reframe coaches, I wouldn’t have 3+ (and counting) years under my belt. Reframe is, in my opinion, a gateway to sobriety for the sober curios. It is affordable, user friendly, and their low pressure approach to sobriety is great for helping people kick off their journey into an alcohol free life.
author: Leah

title: Incredibly helpful
text: I can’t say enough about this app and the community on it. This app helps in so many ways. It paves the way to sobriety (or cutting back) by providing an amazing community that is incredibly welcoming. They provide knowledge on so many different levels. You learn about how alcohol affects your brain, your body, influences your behavior in so many ways most people don’t know. It is an amazing tool for your journey regardless of what that looks like for you. Highly highly recommend
author: Shane Porter

title: Watch out for this group
text: Watch out for these folks.  They automatically renew like you are a customer for life.  No permission given.  No permission asked.  Stay away.

Advertise that it's to cut down, but in reality just the same old "demon rum" philosophy dressed up with a lot of pseudoscience. title: Very poor experience
text:
Key features stopped working after a few months. Got ZERO support. Interface is very cluttered, science questionable, and full of additional costs and ads to get you to buy more content, even with a paid subscription. Sunnyside is MUCH better. Stay away from this one. 

Edit to add after app reply: you got numerous occasions to "make this better". I reported the issue almost a month ago and just got what seems to be an automated reply asking me to provide more details, which I did, with no results. I lost hope at this point, which is why I submitted this review.

text: I had signed up to try a medication that they recommended. The medication did not work for me and when I asked to have any future shipments canceled I was given the run around. After MANY emails and calls to the support team it was finally handled. In the process I was given bad information and blamed for the fact that their customer support person did not understand my request. Horrible experience.
author: Linda Young

title: I highly recommend reframe for anyone who wants to change the relationship with alcohol
text: I have done a reset before to change my relationship with alcohol use though I have never done the personal work or learned anything about the implications. So with the Reframe app, I have learned so much about physiological implications of drinking about the implications on the brain about the implications on the mind and the working of the mind I would recommend highly the Reframe app to anyone who would like to change the relationship with alcohol, not necessarily to quit, but to cut back to understand their relationship more and the implications on their health.
author: Tana

title: Looks good but is it a scam?
text: Update: I contacted reframe twice as per the response below and received no reply. It has taken me months of time and energy and still no refund. If this isn’t a cash grab, why is it so hard? Original review: What started as curiosity in a free trial has become an extended exercise in seeking a refund for a subscription I did not want or need. While the app has a nice interface, and helpful information that would certainly assist some people, I have to ask: Why does a site targeting vulnerable people make it so hard to cancel a subscription and then extract a genuine refund?

author: Austin Blaschak

title: SCAM!!!
text: SCAM!!!! Signed up for £4.99 starter and have just been told by my wife they’ve been taking £40 a month! Should have checked my bank statements. This is the cost of a gym membership for giving you an article you could get from the internet for free, a vague sentence quote, and a set of fireworks when you tell them you didn’t drink. Avoid like the plague. Absolutely livid about this.
author: Saadet mcadoo

title: Beware auto renewal policy
text:
I started using Reframe a year ago (January 2025) to try “dry January”. I liked the app and found it helpful, but didn’t continue its use. was traveling in January, when it auto-renewed for $99 on 1/31/26.
 I contacted Reframe support on 2/17, asking to cancel and issue a refund, as I didn’t intend to renew. Customer service was polite and cancelled my membership, but  refunded only $49, “the maximum possible refund” I was entitled to. Reframe charged me $50 for 2-1/2 weeks. Beware auto renewals and selfish corporations. You can never win if there’s an issue.
author: Pamela Nosse

title: We were charged 4 times for this app
text: We were charged 4 times for this app.  They refunded 2 of the charges and gave us 1 subscription.  I have been working with them for weeks trying to get this resolved.  To no end. I am cancelling and disputing the charges through my credit card.  App was very nice when it worked, but definitely not worth this headache.
author: Jennifer Meyer

title: If I could give 0 stars I would
text: If I could give 0 stars I would. They are quick to take your money without results. title: Great
text: Great! Works for me perfectly.
author: Felia A.

title: I’ve never “loved” an app before but I…
text: I’ve never “loved” an app before but I truly do this one. I’m on it several times a day and in the evening. I’m so grateful to have an alternative to scrolling social media. text:

I've contacted customer service several times. I was advised to download the app, which I did, but the app won't work until I pay. The app is offering $49 for a full year....1/4 of what I paid.
And, I keep getting emails from the app with even better pricing. Customer Service has not been ant help. It's a total scam. They took $68 from me and I got nothing in return.
author: MisFitz

title: Reframe app has saved my life

author: Ed Gash

title: Not really so useful
text: I have had a subscription to reframe for a couple of years. The 'advice' and support screens are fine - the usual sorts of direction - but I also wanted help with the structure of my attempt(s): specifically, if I try and fail, I don't need my failures detailed. I want to 'restart' - from day 1 - and not see my past failure recorded. It's demotivating. I have requested a reset but I'm told this is impossible - I can start again, but my past drink records and 'awards' are indelible. Not at all supportive. 17 Jan 2026, update: I had a message from reframe asking I contact them to explain what I wanted, despite the detail in my review. I had requested my historical data deleted under GDPR - nothing heard (off to the iCO). Now I'm trying I AM SOBER!
author: Richard Taylor

title: Give yourself the gift of joy, self-love & MORE
text:
This community, it’s not JUST an app, it’s a COMMUNITY, has been one of the best gifts I’ve given myself (after quitting the nasty poison that alcohol is) EVER. Can’t recommend it enough - thank you Refam (our collective label that describes Reframe members as FAMILY) and all the coaches, writers of the daily learnings, creators of the swag (OMG the chocolates are 💣💣💣), and of course to 
 Ziyi Gao and Vedant Pradeep (the founders of the app) - you’ve changed/influenced/helped (for the better!!!) SO many people’s lives - what a gift, THANK YOU ❤️❤️❤️
author: Grace Astraea

title: I wish I had read reviews about unfair…
text: I wish I had read reviews about unfair charging. I signed up for what I had seen was a £4.99 subscription, and did not see anywhere that this would quickly turn into a £100 upfront charge. I was absolutely shocked when I received this charge on Christmas Eve. I haven’t found the app useful and was not using it. I immediately asked for a refund from Apple who refused and reframe said they want to help but to contact Apple, who won’t help. I am devastated at losing this money and having zero ways to appeal. I have since seen numerous reviews of similar experiences. I am considering discussing this as a fraudulent charge with my credit card company as it’s completely not on.
author: MEGAN OTT

title: Improves the human condition!
text: This app is much more than just a way to quit or limit drinking. It offers expansive  science based education and multiple modalities of learning to improve the human condition. I highly recommend Reframe if you want to improve your situation and create a better life!

title: It is truly a community that can help…
text: It is truly a community that can help you quit drinking. Very supporting! Even though there are many people on the app it feels intimate. Coaches are awesome and accessible!
author: Jane R

title: This app has saved my life!
text: This app and community has saved my life! The meetings are full of supportive members who give space for everyone, no matter where they are in their journey.  The mods/coaches offer good, clear and insightful advise. I love my reframe family!
author: Erin Kaimkhani

title: This app has truly helped me to stay sober…
text: This app has truly helped me to stay sober! I can’t say how much it has been a lifesaver! The community is amazing, the coaches are phenomenal, and the education and tools have been a lifesaver. I recommend this app to everyone!

text:
I've tried to cancel this app payment but money still being taken. 
Im very unhappy about this and would not recommend.  I have 3 transactions of £39.99= 119.97 and would like this returned to me and the direct debit cancelled before I take this complaint to the ombudsman.
author: Mrs Frances M Thorp

title: Life-changing support when I needed it most!
text:
I’ve been using Reframe for almost a month and it has honestly been the kindest, most effective tool I’ve ever tried.
The daily neuroscience-based readings are short but eye-opening, the community forum feels like a safe little corner of the internet, and the live meetings (even if I don’t feel brave enough to turn my camera on and share) have been pure gold. I love that nobody is judged and there is so much compassion.
What surprised me most is how much I look forward to opening the app every day, it’s become my calm little ritual alongside my morning coffee :)
If you’re even thinking about changing your relationship with alcohol, just try it. This app doesn’t shout at you; it just gently hands you the tools and the support and lets you find your own way. I’m so grateful I found Reframe!
author: Marcy me

title: This app has CHANGED my life
text:
This app has CHANGED my life. It provides daily tasks, readings on the neuroscience of alcohol and the brain, lots of meetings, meditations, craving games, etc. And what it has given to me the most is an AMAZING and LOVING community of friends and resources to keep me on an alcohol-free journey. I couldn't be more grateful for this place. I don't mind paying the annual fees. Reframe is GOLD! 
The negative reviews are garbage and should be ignored. Try it, it WILL change your life for the better! I am alcohol free for over 2 years at this point.
author: Leah

title: Valuable & Useful Experience
text:
I joined reframe a few years ago then cancelled. I had zero issues cancelling so please don’t believe the “scam” reviews. Customer service is extremely easy to contact and they respond promptly. 

I rejoined reframe in September 2025 because they offer a valuable, effective, and extremely unique experience.

Highly recommend.

text: Reframe has genuinely changed my life. The tools, daily lessons and community support keep me grounded, honest, and moving forward. It’s helped me break out of old habits, stay accountable, and actually believe I can become the man I want to be. I’m grateful for this app every single day.

I like the monthly challenges, like Sober October, Social Connection November, etc.

title: Better life

We work on identifying triggers, getting in touch with our emotions, and together work towards making ourselves better.

The online Zoom meetings, for me, have been a complete game changer. I am able to speak what is on my mind to a supportive community and listen to others wisdom on important self-improvement topics

I am celebrating 11 months alcohol free and I contribute the success to Reframe and the members in the community who support, celebrate and lift one another up.

title: I have been using this app for over 3…

Best coaches, tools, community and successful

The zoom meetings are very supportive and you don't have to turn your camera on or even give your name unless you want to. I am thankful for such a caring community and have achieved my goals.

Do you want to remove or cutback on your alcohol intake- Reframe can help make that happen. We cannot do this alone, connection and community is the only way.

title: Reframe has been a great resource for…
text: Reframe has been a great resource for me. I was referred to the app because I was trying to cutback on drinking. I did the 7 day free trial and really enjoyed the daily readings, check ins, and toolkit that has little games and activities to distract myself from cravings. Then I discovered meetings which has been such a wealth of information and connection. I’ve been able to improve my life because of how robust this app is. title: Reframe has changed my life and made me…

author: Redhotbohemian

title: Reframe has made a huge difference in my life.
text: Reframe has made a huge difference in my life. Both with drinking less and with my emotional health. I tried AA for several years however total abstinence was just not for me. What I like about Reframe is the science based approach. Explaining to you how your mind functions and makes decisions. I am on the “cutback track” . It allows you to reduce your drinking gradually. I’ve now reduced my alcohol consumption by over 50%. The the online community support is fantastic. As well as the online coaches. I’ve had no issues with subscription payments.
author: Houston Pewett

title: Highly recommend
text: Don’t know why some think this is a scam because it is REAL. The community, the tools, the power. There are no words. SO glad I found Reframe!
author: El

title: I’m alive and here for my family because of this app
text:
I’m sad others have had difficulty cancelling after the free trial ended but can’t speak to that as I definitely wanted to keep the subscription going. I’ve only had good experiences with tech support who have fixed issues for me when I’ve had them (only a couple of times in 11 months).

I was at a ‘do or die’ point in my life. I searched for an app to help me keep track of how much I had been drinking so I could safely cut back and found an app that gave me so much more. Withdrawal symptoms were hard and scary but Reframe gave me information, support & reassurance. 

With Reframe there is no judgement about where we are at in our life, just a huge variety of tools and resources and the best thing (which I never thought I would do because of guilt and shame and a crippling social anxiety) is that it has given me access to a community of other people who hold one another up. I can chose to do this or not, it fits in to my pocket and it slots in to any spare moment I have in my day. If the timing works, I listen in or participate in a zoom meeting hosted by a highly qualified coach (there are multiple meetings every day) with camera off or on, using a pseudonym or real name. I’ve even now used the chat function and spoken in meetings which was a huge deal for me. I can post and reply in the forum. Within months I was chatting in a small chat group of people with very similar experiences to me and we keep in touch. 

AA wasn’t for me. With Reframe I don’t have to go to in person meetings with people on a very particular path. I have access to articles, podcasts, courses, all on the basic subscription - I can chose to pay extra for 1:1 coaching but I haven’t done that, other reframers say it has been very useful. 

In just 11 months I have gone from hell to hope, my liver has recovered (WOW) at time of writing this review I have saved $4k by not buying alcohol and lost 15kg.

My kids have a mum again. They are so proud of me and the best thing ever is feeling their hugs and love. Alcohol ruined my life. Reframe gave my life back to me. 

My favourite quote I heard through a reframer when I was on the fence about fighting alcohol use:


“The work is hard, staying drunk is hard. 
Chose your hard.”

Thanks Reframe, you're making the hard so much easier.
author: Shona

title: This app changed my life.
text: This app changed my life. Alcohol free for 3.5 years now thanks to the knowledge, neuroscience and community. ENDLESSLY GRATEFUL TO REFRAME!
author: Khatie Krisztian

title: Reframe saved my life
text: Did the 1 month trial membership, reasoning it was the same cost as one cheap bottle of wine and if it helped me not drink for even one day of that month it would have paid for itself. Fast forward 14 months and change and I haven't had a drink in 423 days. The daily 'tasks' that teach you what alcohol does to your body are enlightening and motivating in themselves, and the zoom meetings lead by some pretty amazing coaches are invaluable. Without this app I'd still be in a very dark place drinking 2+ bottles of wine every night on my way to diabetes and/or liver failure and/or dementia. The $150 CDN subscription has saved me over $9,000 in alcohol purchases. I've also made friendships in the meetings and on the app that will last a lifetime. 10/10 recommend this app to anybody who isn't comfortable with or is questioning the way they drink.
author: Court B

title: Scam scam scam!!!
text: Scam scam scam!!!! Did a quiz and they charged me when I added PayPal details but they charged my bank direct, but I cancelled before any confirmation. Thankfully I reported fraud to my bank and they refunded me
author: Olivia

title: This app is LIFE SAVING!
text:
This app is AMAZING! It’s filled with so many rich resources. It teaches you the neuroscience of how alcohol poisons your brain and body. It is filled with so many tools, there is something for everyone.  They have 2 paths to choose from: cut back or alcohol free, so you have options(and can change anytime!). This is a COMMUNITY of people from all over the world where you make significant connections with others on the same journey. There are multiple zoom meetings every day, with a wide variety of topics hosted by skilled, compassionate coaches. The app includes tools to handle cravings, meditations, challenges, and the ability to track your progress. 
It is a life changing opportunity🙌 
Their customer service has always been  amazing anytime I have had an issue(which is rare)
If you are looking to make a healthy, positive change with the help of a huge community of support, Reframe will deliver💜

title: Unauthorized Charge of $119.99 & False…
text:
Unauthorized Charge of $119.99 & False Advertisement
I downloaded the Reframe app because it was advertised as $4.99 for a one-month trial. After using it for about a week, I found it wasn’t what I expected and deleted both the app and my account. Before doing so, I checked my subscriptions and saw no active subscription listed.

Despite this, I was shocked to find that $119.99 was immediately withdrawn from my account—without any warning or authorization. This charge was completely unexpected and unjustified.

What’s worse is that there’s no valid or accessible contact information to resolve billing issues, which is deeply concerning for an app charging this kind of money. It feels deceptive and predatory.

I do not recommend this app to anyone. I’ve had to dispute the charge with my bank and am considering reporting the issue to consumer protection agencies. Proceed with caution.

title: The app is really working well for me

The daily tasks are quick useful reminders to help achieve my goals and the meetings a really helpful reminder that I am not doing this alone.

title: It worked for me. Great value for money.
text: It is not exactly fair that in order to write an anonymous review on trustpilot you need to change your whole username on your account and it still may not appear as exactly anonymous, which I suspect is the reason for the shockingly low number of positive reviews for Reframe. This is an app for moderating or quitting alcohol so a lot of people who use it prefer to remain anonymous. I’ve had only positive experience with the app, i cannot believe the value you get for the money you pay, there are so many resources available including live meditations and meetings, even on holidays. All coaches I have encountered are non- judgmental, knowledgeable, compassionate, professional and dedicated. I have tried numerous other methods available and only reframe helped me achieve my goals. I think the format of the app is great and it really works.

title: Not recommended at all

title: BEWARE SCAM…
text: Like many others here I signed up for the free trial, realised it wasn't what I was looking for and cancelled immediately. I realized a few days later they had charged me for the full year. I've sent countless emails to which they reply that the refund has been processed their end. It's been over a month and I've yet to get my money back. This is a disgusting scam. Stay away.

title: Very Harmful App, beware
text: Instead of getting professional help, my daughter used this app. She committed suicide 9 months after quitting drinking. She met a scam artist in the guise of "Life Coach", who took her money and fed her mental illness. This app shouldn't exist.
author: Michele Elliott

title: Not happy with Reframe.. don’t do it

author: Stephanie Lynn

title: Don’t do it
text: Don’t do it. The app is patronising, judgemental and very heterosexual oriented. It’s also very targeted towards Americans. I didn’t learn anything new from this app other than being and feeling judged. The limits you set are not monitored, there’s no encourage t and the app looks at selling other products to you. If you’re looking to give up alcohol do it yourself as I did after 8 weeks trying unsuccessfully with reframe. 8 weeks after using the app I’m alcohol free with no need for their homophobic ‘lessons’ and judgement of behaviour
author: Chris

title: I had to write a review on Reframe…
text:
I had to write a review on Reframe after reading all the negative reviews on here.  I have been on Reframe for just over 200 days and sober for the same amount of time.  

The app, the community within it and the coaches have been nothing short of incredible.  They are the reason I have remained (happily sober) all this time.  I have tried to get sober for over 10 years and this time it's sticking.  The fee doesn't even come close to reflecting it's worth.  Imagine how much you spend on alcohol, therapists or even rehab?  There are many Reframe users on the app who have failed with conventional rehab and found Reframe to be more successful.

Some people have done a mix of different therapies and found that useful.  All is accepted on Reframe.  You are not shamed for slip ups, that's all part of the journey. 

I have even given up smoking and other substances with the support of Reframe.  

I have felt supported by the community and coaches and empowered by the knowledge of how the brain gets hijacked by alcohol.  I have learnt so much about myself and why I drank.  It's not just about quitting alcohol. It's about the human condition and for this knowledge and the confidence it has given me I am truly grateful.

The online zoom meetings are a game changer.

 I urge anyone with alcohol abuse issues to try Reframe, even if it's for a month.  I know now that I will never question the decision to stop drinking.  Thanks Reframe for changing my life.
author: Mazza

title: I agreed to a 7 day trial with the…
text:
I agreed to a 7 day trial. On the 7th day I was charged $174 for a yearly subscription which was never in my budget. I now realise Apple is affiliated with them as I was refused a refund from reframe then sent a link to the App Store to request a refund which was refused and no other avenues to dispute this.
I’ve put in a formal complaint to the ombudsman i will keep everyone updated. Thought it was a helpful app but yet another greedy heartless corporation..
Steer clear all the information they supply is free online. Luck everyone on there journeys 🙏
author: Tanyia

title: This is a disgusting scam
text: This is a disgusting scam, do NOT JOIN, I’m a reporter acting as an alcoholic who needs support and this app will take your money and give NOTHING.
author: Anonymous

title: SCAM, taking advantage of vulnerable people
text:
The sheer fact that you have to pay and be in a subscription for basic alcohol awareness, makes this a scam.

It does contain scientific knowledge, however, this is all accessible online and through free sources in the community. 

If you're going to pay for help for maintaining/cutting your alcohol use, please seek professional help.
author: Trevor

title: Science and behavioral backed game  changer
text: I found this app after just getting disgusted with myself about my inability to just cut back or stop drinking. I was definitely not rock-bottom, ie not  drinking a bottle a day, but I could easily throw back two Manhattans plus a glass of wine over dinner and go to work the next day. Got sick of it. Read all the reviews of the different apps.   And tried this one as well as some others. (Sunnyside, DryDay etc) . This is by far the best and yes it is paid but worth every dime. It certainly costs less than your alcohol budget that’s for sure! As the program goes on, the goal becomes how to rebuild your life, Not just about drinking, and addressing deeply rooted issues. It’s about the whole journey, not just about booze. I wanted the science behind drinking, habits and how they form, and how to change my mind-set. And understand why I drink, and over time Reframe has made my triggers more obvious and helped me turn away from alcohol as a daily crutch. I have recommended it to my friends, my partner , and my primary care and other doctors. I will always be grateful to the developers and folks that have backed this app.  Thank you Reframe!
author: Katherine Sullivan

title: Scammy sales tactics, steer well clear
text:
At best unethical, have reported them for mis-selling. Promote free or low cost trials but proceed to levy a full year’s charge. Refer you to Apple for cancellation/refund though clearly there is something amiss in this process as Apple simply reject the request (not been the case where I’ve had lesser issues with other app subs in the past). As others have said Reframe then offer an arbitrary 50% refund. Easy money for them! Currently looking into official routes to complain given this is evidently a common behaviour. Shame as the app is actually ok, but do yourself a favour and avoid the people selling it at all costs.

UPDATE: They have replied to this review after over a year giving me a route to raise concerns. Which says a lot. Having experienced their customer service at length already I shan’t waste my time on it further, so I’ll just stick by the review above.
author: Andy

title: SCAM
text: Do NOT give this company money they are a complete scam. I signed up for a free trial and was charged for a years subscription the same day. I reached out to them and even offered to pay for a month instead of the full year, that it was clearly a mistake. They first refused, then offered a refund if I logged in every day for 60 days - then finally offered me 50% off, all of which is completely unacceptable since I signed up for what was advertised as a free trial. They are predatory, and it particularly unsettling that they prey on people during a vulnerable time and exploit their looking for community, support, and help. DISGUSTING.
author: Taya Kenny

title: This app is exactly what I needed
text: This app is exactly what I needed. I like the daily tasks and the challenges that keep me mindful of my choices. I enjoy the forum and sharing with others who have walked in my shoes. I had never tried mediation or visualization but because it is a part of the daily lessons I see the benefits it those things. I am 67 and have struggled with alcohol my whole life. Currently 34 day’s alcohol free.
